anti_collapse.decisive_reason: Joint construction and global-consistency filtering of competing offset/gap assignments across long overlapping count sequences survives neutralization; the archivist baseline without dendro/signal specialization explicitly does not assume quantitative alignment of long measured sequences as customary, so this changes which chronologies survive and which anchor is checked.

action.rationale: Neutralized action jointly builds competing offset/gap assignments across all long overlaps and filters by measurement bounds and independent anchors, then does a discriminating anchor check with global recheck. Ordinary actions are trace custody/creators and compare dated references, handwriting, postmarks, paper and event mentions, cross-checking clues. Baseline states quantitative alignment of long measured sequences is not assumed customary, so joint offset/gap construction is not substantially ordinary.

inferential_warrant.rationale: Warrant that converging correspondence plus anchors constrain chronology while unresolved fits remain as alternative intervals, with impression-to-letter bridge separately bounded, restates ordinary patterns: converging independent clues constrain an interval, pattern comparison can support relative sequence while ambiguous matches remain unresolved, and custody/arrangement does not establish order. No new inferential license.

next_inquiry.rationale: After neutralization the next step is seek an independent anchor and report global consistency and residual ambiguity, which matches ordinary next actions to seek independent anchors, check conflicting clues, compare another document and preserve alternative chronologies and uncertain intervals. The follow-up inquiry type is ordinary even though the hypothesis space it operates on is jointly generated.

observable.rationale: Neutralized observables are jointly compatible offsets, gap patterns, anchor conflicts and surviving alternative chronologies derived from count sequences. Ordinary evidence is letters, envelopes, accession records, dated calendars, material clues and event records with uncertain intervals. No ordinary observable corresponds to joint compatibility across overlaps or systematic gap-pattern objects.

problem_decomposition.rationale: Decomposition into joint chronology variables plus gap alternatives plus anchors replacing isolated letter-by-letter dating decisions changes problem structure. Ordinary decomposition is per-letter provenance comparison plus generic cross-check and preservation of intervals. Joint variables impose simultaneous constraints across all overlaps, not present in baseline.

formalization.new_epistemic_constraint: Retain only offset/gap assignments jointly compatible across all overlaps within measurement bounds and independent anchors; use the permitted anchor check where survivors differ and recheck global consistency, otherwise report residual ambiguity without forcing a date.
formalization.rationale: This constraint governs which chronologies survive and which observation to perform next. Ordinary baseline only requires generic cross-check, seek anchors and preserve intervals, without joint-compatibility filtering or discriminating-selection. Operational consequence is a different surviving set and different anchor choice than per-letter cross-checking would produce.

materiality.rationale: Joint global-consistency filtering determines which chronologies survive, which gaps are allowed, and which anchor is informative. Isolated provenance checks cannot generate or adjudicate that hypothesis space. This changes how inquiry proceeds, not mere renaming, decoration or bookkeeping of ordinary cross-checks.

native_reduction.closest_native_equivalent: Trace custody/creators, compare dated references, handwriting, postmarks, paper and annual-event mentions letter-by-letter, cross-check independent dating clues, use simple pattern comparison to suggest relative order, and preserve uncertain intervals and alternative chronologies.
lost_if_reduced: joint offset/gap hypothesis space across all overlaps
global compatibility filtering by measurement bounds and anchors
gap-pattern and anchor-conflict observables that discriminate survivors
native_reduction.rationale: Replacing joint quantitative alignment with per-letter provenance comparison loses the ability to generate, constrain and select among globally consistent offset/gap assignments for omitted/duplicated increments across long overlaps; ordinary cross-checking and simple pattern comparison provide no equivalent operation.

uncertainty: Baseline is scoped authored hypothesis, not verified practitioner consensus; scope of ordinary pattern comparison for material clues retains some ambiguity.

Whether impression counts might be inspected as material clues is ambiguous, but joint quantitative alignment of long sequences is explicitly not assumed customary, so ambiguity does not defeat departure.
